description: One-component, anti-corrosion cementitious mortar for steel reinforcement rods
whereToUse: Corrosion-inhibiting protection of concrete reinforcing rods
Adhesion improver for concrete repair mortars.

Re-alkalising corrosion-inhibiting protection for reinforcing rods in the repair of concrete carried out with shrinkage-compensated mortars from the Mapegrout range or with standard cement mortars modified with synthetic based latex.
It can also be used for underground concrete construction.
notFor: Do not further dilute Mapefer 1K with water when the product begins to set.
Do not add cement or aggregates to Mapefer 1K.
Do not apply Mapefer 1K when the temperature is below +5°C.

standards.value: meets the requirements defined by EN 1504-9
resistant to saline fog according to EN 15183
certified as EC1 Plus by the German association GEV

consumption.basis: water content used for laboratory test samples (technical data table), per 100 parts by weight of powder
consumption.quote: 100 parts by weight of Mapefer 1K with 20.5 % water.

mixing: Pour 1.0-1.1 l of clean water into a clean container and, while mixing, slowly disperse 5 kg of Mapefer 1K.
packaging: The product is available in cartons each one containing 4 bags of 5 kg.
storage: Mapefer 1K may be stored for up to 24 months in its original packaging in a dry place at a temperature not below +5°C.
notes: 1) Consumption is given for two rod diameters only (8 mm and 16 mm, at 2 mm of applied product); there is no formula and no figure for other diameters, so anything else would be an interpolation the sheet does not print. 2) The sheet does not say whether '100 g/m' / '200 g/m' is dry powder or mixed product. 3) Water is printed as '1.0-1.1 kg of water' per 5 kg in the application table and '1.0-1.1 l of clean water' in the prose; the laboratory mix is '20.5 % water'. These agree. 4) Timings: table says waiting time between coats 'approx. 2 hours' and before repair mortar '6-24 hours'; prose says second coat 'approximately 2 hours after ... and preferably within 24 hours' and repairs 'once Mapefer 1K has dried (approximately 6 hours at +20°C)'. 5) The fourth RECOMMENDATIONS bullet is an instruction rather than a limit and is not in notFor: apply immediately after sandblasting, do not leave clean rods exposed and without protection for long periods. 6) This is the international 'en (IT)' edition issued by Mapei S.p.A. Milan, not a UAE edition. It also carries a 'CO2e FULLY OFFSET PRODUCTS' statement for the year 2026.
